arStrings.szText: "Are you sure there's no other way?"
The blood can’t be purged. We could ward it, toss it into the sea—but then it’s someone else’s problem. And that’s the one mistake of Donan’s I refuse to repeat.
That’s if I can even figure out how to summon Astaroth in the first place. Elias’ notes here are incomplete. Could you look around?
